scientific_question: Will the frozen learned source-neutral affine GF2 operator transfer to causal laws outside its training primitive class, and can a separate learned quadratic-basis shared operator generalize beyond the old affine class against fully trained equally informed nonlinear controls?

families.name: nonlinear_cross_role_quadratic
families.law: Hidden source-neutral 4-bit outputs from sparse mixed GF2 linear and pairwise AND interactions across target current/lag, source current/lag and events, with extra source-to-target cross products. At least one hidden nonzero quadratic coefficient for every output bit.

families.name: modular_carry_composition
families.law: Hidden source-neutral nonlinear arithmetic composed of 4-bit modular additions, rotation and XOR, including bit carry interactions of polynomial degree > 2 in general; designed as an OUT-OF-CLASS control for both affine and quadratic classes.

pre_registered_sourcefree.negative: Hold target/source/event/initial and output inventory fixed, swap different-role observed tokens for each heldout positive.

arms.name: learned_shared_quadratic
arms.basis: 20 public raw causal bits + 1 constant + all pairwise AND monomials (211 total), source-neutral all entity bindings; data chosen by FIT only; deterministic pivot priorities, no CHECK updates

arms.name: independent_pooled_nonlinear_GF2
arms.basis: same complete 211 fixed monomials, same 24 FIT trajectories; independent elimination, no candidate import or privileged source law

arms.name: independent_edge_quadratic
arms.basis: same complete 211 monomials, six independently fitted directed edge programs (all public source/target states), same FIT/check

fairness: Both pooled nonlinear learners and edge-specific nonlinear learner receive exactly the same complete 211 nonlinear public feature inventory; the older frozen affine learner is a deliberate expressivity-limited reference and RNN an independent sequence-aware reference. Zero source-generator imports within fit/predict code.

admission.native_steps: All eight events in positive and matched negative trajectories, no early return.
admission.CPU_RSS: five repeats per original sourcefree arm/family/seed, Linux wait4 full Python/import/FIT/CHECK/positive and negative predictions; retain exact process costs, no equal-FLOP claim
admission.interpretation: Any quadratic success is strictly within disclosed expanded quadratic hypothesis class, never independent unknown-law discovery; any modular-carry failure demonstrates limits. Lack of fairness in native parameter counts must be explicit.
